content.text: In Nigeria, Stripe is blocked for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-works|How Digital]] creators, stranding them without a way to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-8|payment]]s or manage their store infrastructure. This problem repeats in Zimbabwe, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, and many other countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. The solution is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that gives creators control and flexibility, regardless of their location.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure, consisting of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-complete-infrastructure-4|COREMERCH guide to supabase]] or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This infrastructure is designed to be self-contained, so creators can deploy and manage their own stack without relying on external platforms. Each option provides a set of predefined workflows and configurations that enable creators to launch their store quickly and easily. For example, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, allowing creators to deploy a fully functional store in 48 hours. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) adds Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing more advanced features and scalability.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

COREMERCH's solution is designed to bypass geo-restrictions and allow creators to operate their store in countries where payment platforms are restricted. By using open-source and self-hosted infrastructure, creators can avoid the risk of having their account suspended or frozen by payment processors. This is particularly important for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides creators with everything they need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including 6 blueprints and 7 templates.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments is the payment processor used by COREMERCH, and it offers fast and secure payment processing with no KYC requirements. The fees are low, with a fixed 0.5% fee on all transactions. This is significantly lower than the fees charged by traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal. In addition, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing creators to accept a wide range of payment options. Overall, the payment speed and fees are key advantages of COREMERCH's solution, making it an attractive option for creators who want to minimize their costs and maximize their revenue.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can avoid the risk of having their account suspended or frozen by payment processors.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of COREMERCH's solution is that creators own all their store infrastructure, including the code, customer list, order history, and product files. This means they have complete control over their data and can modify or customize their infrastructure as needed. The automation features of the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) allow creators to streamline their workflows and save time, while the delivery features of Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensure that customers receive their products quickly and efficiently. Overall, the ownership, automation, and delivery features of COREMERCH's solution make it an attractive option for creators who want to take control of their store and maximize their revenue.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture depends on the creator's specific needs and requirements. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a good option for creators who want a simple and easy-to-use solution, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a better choice for creators who need more advanced features and scalability. Creators should consider factors such as their budget, technical expertise, and the level of customization required. By choosing the right architecture, creators can ensure that their store is fast, secure, and scalable, and that they can maximize their revenue and grow their business.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The most important question a creator should ask is: 'Which architecture should I choose for my sovereign digital commerce stack?' The answer depends on their specific needs and requirements, but generally, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a good option for beginners, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a better choice for more advanced creators who need more features and scalability. By choosing the right architecture, creators can ensure that their store is fast, secure, and scalable, and that they can maximize their revenue and grow their business.
By using open-source and self-hosted infrastructure, creators can ensure that their store is fast, secure, and scalable.

For creators who want to learn more about sovereign digital commerce stacks and how to build, deploy, and scale their own store, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a valuable resource. This kit provides everything creators need to get started, including 6 blueprints and 7 templates. By using the Complete Builder Kit, creators can save time and money, and ensure that their store is fast, secure, and scalable. Additionally, creators can visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore other products and solutions that can help them grow their business.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack with COREMERCH, follow these concrete steps: 1) Choose the right architecture for your store, based on your specific needs and requirements. 2) Select the relevant blueprints and templates from the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to help you build and deploy your stack. 3) Set up your NOWPayments account and configure the payment processor to accept your preferred cryptocurrencies. 4) Deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and configure the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5) Set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets, and configure file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6) Test your store thoroughly to ensure that it is fast, secure, and scalable.
